items.reason: Gap 1 describes a retry arriving while the first handler runs, passing the set check before the id is inserted and running the handler twice.
Gap 0 says dedup keys on the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that a forged header defeats dedup.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler map registers refund.created, so refunds are never recorded.
No gap depends on several processes or replicas; the race concerns concurrent jobs in one queue.
